newsitem.title: USA: Fabri-Centers to redeem debt, incur charge.
newsitem.headline: Fabri-Centers to redeem debt, incur charge.

text.p: Fabri-Centers of America Inc said Tuesday its board authorized the redemption of the company's outstanding 6-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due March 1, 2002.
The company said it estimates it will incur a second quarter extraordinary charge of about $1.2 million, or $0.06 per share, net of taxes, upon redemption of all debentures.
Fabri-Centers said the redemption is authorized at a price of 101.785 percent of principal, plus payment of accrued interest to the date of redemption.
The redemption is authorized for June 30.

It said debenture holders will have until June 30 to convert their debentures or to accept redemption at the stated premium. Each $1,000 principal amount of debentures is convertible into an aggregate of about 20.513 class A common shares and 20.513 class B common shares, at a conversion price of $24.375 per share.
The company said it has about $57 million of debentures outstanding. It said it would fund the redemption through use of its long-term credit facilities.
